0022600206.text: The Raptors (5-4) host the Grizzlies (6-3) in Toronto's 10th game of the season. Toronto sits 3rd in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and 5th in the East after a win in its most recent game, while Memphis is 3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 7th in the West, having lost its last three games despite a 4-0 road record. Toronto is without Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), and Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Raptors won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 128-96 regular-season win in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
